vehicle_types.name: E-Bike
vehicle_types._description:
- Model ramy "SWAP" z Framelockiem
 - widelec e-CFC DLS ze złączem ładowania oraz chipem RFID
 - Aluminiowy koszyk z panelem reklamowym
 - Hamulce rolkowe z przodu i z tyłu
 - Czytnik kart RFID

vehicle_types.name: Rower standardowy
vehicle_types._description:
- p-nextbike frame with BL9 Framelock
- Fork with integrated steering stop
- DLS ready
- Aluminium basket with ad panel
- fully enclosed front light and solar panel
- fully enclosed cockpit with mobile phone holder
- Saddle with anti-theft protection
- freewheel, rollerbrake rear and front
- BSIOT
